description: Neon space shooter 'Star Frontier'. Top-down. Player spaceship bottom center. WASD/arrows move, space autofire. Enemies from top in waves. 3 types: small zigzag (1hp), cruiser shoots back (3hp), boss every 5 waves (20hp, 3 patterns). Powerups: shield 5s, triple shot 10s, speed x2. Parallax stars, muzzle flash, 20+ particle explosions, screen shake on hit, fire trail. HUD: lives icons, score center, wave right, boss bar bottom. Title screen, ESC pause, game over screen. Music from start. Difficulty scales 5% per wave. Combo multiplier. Space theme, dark blue, neon cyan player, red enemies.
title: Star Frontier
